'''F8-N0''', or simply '''En-oh''', was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served as an assistant to [[Keikana Herot]], the Science Commander of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa's]] forces at [[Wardpost Duvaal]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. F8-N0 assisted Herot in her research into the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].
